definitions: A dough-like food made from boiled and pounded starchy root vegetables (such as cassava, yams, or plantains), common in West and Central African cuisine.
A traditional staple food in many African countries, often served with soups or stews.
examples: She learned to make fufu from her grandmother.
The fufu was served with a spicy peanut soup.
They enjoyed a meal of fufu and egusi stew.
